items.title: Modhumoti Bank kicks off cybersecurity awareness month
items.description: Modhumoti Bank PLC has held a launching event for the National Cybersecurity Awareness Month 2026 at its head office to promote secure digital banking and strengthen cybersecurity awareness among employees.

items.title: Hormuz could be ‘redundant’ in five years
items.description: Investment in alternative logistics routes in the Gulf to mitigate the impact of the Iran war could make the Strait of Hormuz “redundant” in the next five years, HSBC Group Chief Executive Georges Elhedery said on Tuesday.

items.title: Financial connectivity key to Bangladesh-China ties
items.description: A stronger presence of Chinese financial institutions in Bangladesh could benefit both countries and help turn investment decisions into action, said Ashik Chowdhury, chairman of Invest Bangladesh.

items.title: Uttara Bank holds annual risk management conference
items.description: Uttara Bank PLC recently held its annual risk management conference for 2026 at Sea Pearl Beach Resort & Spa in Cox’s Bazar.

items.title: Anti-money laundering compliance officers elect new leaders
items.description: The Association of Anti-Money Laundering Compliance Officers of Banks in Bangladesh (AACOBB) has recently elected a 15-member executive committee for the 2026-27 term.

items.title: Pubali Bank holds quarterly ADC, card business review meeting
items.description: Pubali Bank PLC recently held its third-quarter ADC (alternative delivery channel) and card business review meeting for 2026 at the bank’s head office auditorium.
